title: Support for IEEE 802.1CB R-Tags (EtherType 0xF1C1)
description:
IEEE 802.1CB (Frame Replication and Elimination for Reliability - "FRER" in short) specifies a so-called Redundancy Tag (R-Tag) with EtherType 0xF1C1 followed by a 16-bit reserved field (all-zeros) and a 16-bit sequence number.

It is placed in a frame just like a VLAN tag.

Here's a dissector for it.
